docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $980.00 FILED BY BHAS, SANJAY AS TO DEFENDANT CAMPOS, JOHNO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-15-2023 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE $88. SERVED OCT-16-2023, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT CAMPOS, JOHNO

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-15-2023 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO NOV-29-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. NO HEARING HELD. NO APPEARANCE BY THE PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCE BY THE DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. KANE (D. 506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-29-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO JAN-30-2024 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SANJAY BHAS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOHNO CAMPOS IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PROOF OF SERVICE IS DEFECTIVE. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-30-2024 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-30-2024 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SANJAY BHAS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOHNO CAMPOS IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATED THE DEFENDANT HAS AGREED TO PAY HIM $200 A MONTH FOR THE NEXT 6 MONTHS AND WOULD LIKE A PROGRESS REPORT DATE. IF NO APPEARANCES AT THE NEXT HEARING, THIS MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: D. CARTER. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF SANJAY BHAS IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOHNO CAMPOS IS NOT PRESENT. JUDGE: JOSEPH HURLEY; CLERK: D. CARTER. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
